title: The Death of Absalom

questions.question: Who were the three commanders David advised?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:2 (ESV): "And David sent out the army, one third under the command of Joab, one third under the command of Abishai... and one third under the command of Ittai..."

questions.question: What command did David give concerning Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:5 (ESV): "And the king commanded Joab... 'Deal gently for my sake with the young man Absalom.'"

questions.question: How did Absalom get caught?
options: His head caught in an oak tree
questions.correctAnswer: His head caught in an oak tree
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:9 (ESV): "...and his head caught fast in the oak, and he was suspended between heaven and earth..."

questions.question: Who killed Absalom?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:14-15 (ESV): "...And he took three javelins... and thrust them into the heart of Absalom... And ten young men... struck Absalom and killed him."

questions.question: What was David's reaction to Absalom's death?
options: He was deeply moved and wept
questions.correctAnswer: He was deeply moved and wept
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:33 (ESV): "And the king was deeply moved and went up to the chamber over the gate and wept."

questions.question: Why did the people not let David go out to battle?
options: He was worth ten thousand of them
questions.correctAnswer: He was worth ten thousand of them
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:3 (ESV): "...But you are worth ten thousand of us. Therefore it is better that you send us help from the city."

questions.question: Where did the battle take place?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:6 (ESV): "...and the battle faced in the forest of Ephraim."

questions.question: What devoured more people than the sword that day?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:8 (ESV): "...and the forest devoured more people that day than the sword."

questions.question: Who ran to bring news to David first?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:23 (ESV): "...Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain and outran the Cushite."

questions.question: What monument had Absalom set up for himself?
options: A pillar in the King's Valley
questions.correctAnswer: A pillar in the King's Valley
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:18 (ESV): "Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and set up for himself the pillar that is in the King's Valley..."

questions.question: What did the man say he wouldn't do even for 1,000 pieces of silver?
options: Raise his hand against the king's son
questions.correctAnswer: Raise his hand against the king's son
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:12 (ESV): "...Even if I felt in my hand the weight of a thousand pieces of silver, I would not reach out my hand against the king's son..."

questions.question: How was Absalom buried?
options: Thrown into a great pit in the forest and covered with stones
questions.correctAnswer: Thrown into a great pit in the forest and covered with stones
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:17 (ESV): "And they took Absalom and threw him into a great pit in the forest and raised over him a very great heap of stones."

questions.question: What did Ahimaaz see when he ran?
options: A great tumult, but he didn't know what
questions.correctAnswer: A great tumult, but he didn't know what
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:29 (ESV): "...I saw a great tumult, but I do not know what it was."

questions.question: Who told the Cushite to run?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:21 (ESV): "Then Joab said to the Cushite, 'Go, tell the king what you have seen.'"

questions.question: What did David cry out as he wept?
options: O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! Would I had died instead of you
questions.correctAnswer: O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! Would I had died instead of you
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 18:33 (ESV): "...saying as he went, 'O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! Would I had died instead of you...!'"

key_verse_text: And the king was deeply moved and went up to the chamber over the gate and wept. And as he went, he said, “O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! Would I had died instead of you, O Absalom, my son, my son!” (ESV)
